sources.title: Granite-4.1-3B: Private 3B LLM for Ops Automation
sources.snippet: 3B instruction-tuned model for private ops automation, tool-calling workflows, and embedded AI agents in data-sensitive environments. Granite-4.1-3B is a 3.4B-parameter instruct model from IBM, finetuned with open-source and synthetic data for tool calling, RAG, code tasks, and multilingual support (12 languages).
